messages.subject: keeping grouped factor w/ Rowwise
parts:
I know from Github that this is being discussed, but how can I get the grouping factors in the following?

 qs <- mtcars %>%
+     group_by(cyl) %>%
+     summarise(y = list(quantile(mpg))) %>% rowwise() %>% summarise(q25=y[2],q75=y[4])
> qs
Source: local data frame [3 x 2]

    q25   q75
1 22.80 30.40
2 18.65 21.00
3 14.40 16.25

I can rbind with a different summarize statement, but I don't think that was what was intended.
Thanks - Derek

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: keeping grouped factor w/ Rowwise
parts:
The current ugly work around is:

summarise(cyl = cyl[1], q25=y[2],q75=y[4])

Hadley
